name: Kirjathaim
overview: Kirjathaim, also known as Kiriathaim, is identified in Scripture as both a city within the territory of the tribe of Reuben and a Levitical city in the land of Naphtali. The city holds significance in biblical history as a fortified location built by the children of Reuben and is mentioned among the border cities of Moab. Prophecies in Jeremiah and Ezekiel speak of Kiriathaim's downfall and distress as part of God's judgment against Moab, highlighting its role as a symbol of the Lord's sovereign power over nations.
